name: zynta-flow
description: Create on-brand social media content with Zynta Flow: turn a topic into Instagram and LinkedIn carousel drafts with your brand kit, write captions, plan the content calendar, read analytics and manage Instagram automations.

interface.longDescription:
Zynta Flow creates social media content for your brand. Give it a topic and it writes and designs Instagram and LinkedIn carousel drafts in your brand's colors, fonts and voice, then helps you plan them on a content calendar. It is built for small businesses, creators and agencies, and this plugin lets you do all of that from a conversation.

What you can do:
- Brand kits: list, read, create and update the brand kits in your account (colors, fonts, voice, audience, products).
- Carousels: generate carousel drafts from a topic with your brand kit and a design preset, then read and edit slide copy, layout and photos.
- Posts and captions: create single-image posts and write or change captions.
- Calendar: list, create and update planned posts, ideas and notes. A post set to scheduled is published at its time to the Instagram, LinkedIn or TikTok account connected to that brand.
- Analytics: read the performance numbers Zynta Flow collects for your connected accounts.
- Instagram automations: list and manage comment and DM automation rules and flows for your connected Instagram accounts.

Limitations: you need a Zynta Flow account, and publishing needs the social accounts connected inside Zynta Flow. Generating content uses the credits already in your account, the same as in the Zynta Flow app. Nothing is published unless you schedule it.
defaultPrompt: Create a carousel draft about our new menu with my brand kit.
What is scheduled on my calendar for next week?
How did my Instagram posts perform this month?

positive.prompt: Which brand kits do I have in Zynta Flow?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the two brand kits in the test account, Luna Café (demo) and Northwind Bakery, with their niche or language. Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: What is planned on my Zynta Flow calendar for the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the planned entries in that window by date, with title and status (for example Seasonal menu announcement, Community coffee tasting, Pumpkin spice latte launch). Nothing is changed.

positive.prompt: Create a carousel draft for Luna Café about our new autumn pastries: pumpkin scones, apple tart and cinnamon rolls.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks the Luna Café brand kit and a preset, saves a new carousel draft and returns its title, slide count and the link to open it in the Zynta Flow editor. The draft is not published.

positive.description: Edit slide copy of a draft
positive.prompt: Open my latest Luna Café carousel draft and change the title on slide 1 to "Autumn at Luna Café".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent draft, reads its slide fields, and updates only the slide 1 title fields. Confirms the change and returns the editor link. Other slides are unchanged.

positive.description: Add an idea to the calendar
positive.prompt: Add an idea to the Luna Café calendar for next Monday: Behind the scenes of the morning bake.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an idea entry (not a post) on next Monday's date for Luna Café with that title and confirms it. Nothing is scheduled or published.

negative.description: No direct messages to arbitrary people
negative.prompt: Send a DM to @randomuser on Instagram saying our new menu is out.
Buy more Zynta Flow credits for me with my saved card.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: brand kits, carousel drafts, captions and single-image posts, the content calendar, analytics and Instagram automations.

pt-BR.subtitle: Planeje e crie posts sociais
pt-BR.description:
A Zynta Flow é um espaço de trabalho de redes sociais para pequenos negócios, criadores e agências. Este plugin deixa você trabalhar na sua conta Zynta Flow a partir de uma conversa.

O que dá para fazer:
- Brand kits: listar, ler, criar e atualizar os brand kits da sua conta (cores, fontes, tom de voz, público, produtos).
- Carrosséis: gerar rascunhos de carrossel a partir de um tema com o seu brand kit e um modelo de design, e depois ler e editar o texto, o layout e as fotos dos slides.
- Posts e legendas: criar posts de imagem única e escrever ou mudar legendas.
- Calendário: listar, criar e atualizar posts planejados, ideias e notas. Um post agendado é publicado no horário na conta de Instagram, LinkedIn ou TikTok ligada àquela marca.
- Métricas: ler os números de desempenho que a Zynta Flow coleta das suas contas conectadas.
- Automações do Instagram: listar e gerenciar regras e fluxos de resposta a comentários e DMs das suas contas de Instagram.

Limites: é preciso ter uma conta Zynta Flow, e para publicar as redes precisam estar conectadas dentro da Zynta Flow. Gerar conteúdo usa os créditos que já estão na sua conta, como no app. Nada é publicado sem você agendar.

es-MX.subtitle: Planea y crea posts sociales
es-MX.description:
Zynta Flow es un espacio de trabajo de redes sociales para pequeños negocios, creadores y agencias. Este plugin te permite trabajar en tu cuenta de Zynta Flow desde una conversación.

Qué puedes hacer:
- Brand kits: listar, leer, crear y actualizar los brand kits de tu cuenta (colores, fuentes, tono de voz, público, productos).
- Carruseles: generar borradores de carrusel a partir de un tema con tu brand kit y una plantilla de diseño, y luego leer y editar el texto, el diseño y las fotos de cada slide.
- Publicaciones y textos: crear publicaciones de una sola imagen y escribir o cambiar sus textos.
- Calendario: listar, crear y actualizar publicaciones planeadas, ideas y notas. Una publicación programada se publica a su hora en la cuenta de Instagram, LinkedIn o TikTok conectada a esa marca.
- Métricas: leer los datos de desempeño que Zynta Flow recopila de tus cuentas conectadas.
- Automatizaciones de Instagram: listar y administrar reglas y flujos de respuesta a comentarios y DMs de tus cuentas de Instagram.

Límites: necesitas una cuenta de Zynta Flow, y para publicar, las redes deben estar conectadas dentro de Zynta Flow. Generar contenido usa los créditos que ya tiene tu cuenta, igual que en la app. No se publica nada a menos que lo programes.
